title: The Loyalty Tax
hook: Your "company loyalty" is actually a hidden tax on your lifetime earnings.
script:
(Visual: Split screen. Left side: An employee staying at one firm for 5 years. Right side: An employee switching every 2 years.)

"Most Indian professionals are taught that loyalty is a virtue. In the corporate world, it's a financial liability."

"Here is the first-principles math: Internal raises are designed to keep you just above the 'quit threshold.' They are based on budget cycles and manager whims."

"Market value, however, is based on supply and demand. When you switch, you aren't asking for a raise; you are resetting your price to the current market rate."

"By staying 'loyal' for five years, you aren't building security. You are paying a 'Loyalty Tax'—the difference between your internal increment and your external market value."

"The company isn't betraying you; they are simply optimizing their costs. The question is: why aren't you optimizing yours?"
caption: Loyalty is for friends and family. In a capitalist labor market, your only true security is your market value, not your tenure. Stop paying the Loyalty Tax. #RationalThoughts #CareerStrategy #IndianCorporate #FirstPrinciples
